def snap(f):
    d={}
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:

        if n['pixels']>=4:
            d.setdefault(n['color'],[]).append((n['pixels'],min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)))
    return d
# Current: red=stack(B), blue=slotA. Try red=train(A), blue=aboveBoxB(B).
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':19,'col':48}])  # red -> train
s=snap(current_frame); print("red->train:", {k:v for k,v in s.items() if k in 'Rb'}, "done:",last_action_result.get('done'))
if not last_action_result.get('done'):
    action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':36,'col':48}])  # blue -> above box B
    s=snap(current_frame); print("blue->boxB:", {k:v for k,v in s.items() if k in 'Rb'}, "done:",last_action_result.get('done'))
    print("N:", s.get('N'), "Y:", s.get('Y'))
</parameter>
</function>

def snap(f):
    d={}
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
        if n['pixels']>=4:
            d.setdefault(n['color'],[]).append((n['pixels'],min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)))
    return d
